messages:
Kei: Quick thread  proposing a left-rail reorg by user journey (Build > Deploy > Monitor) to reduce context switching. Attached mini-mock. Main asks: permalink stability, breadcrumb copy, and keyboard navigation. Thoughts?

Marta: Love the flow-first approach. Two concerns: 1) deep links are used in docs and onboarding, we must ensure existing `/console/models/:id` links still resolve, 2) screen-reader behaviour when clusters collapse.

Devon: For URLs I suggest a thin routing layer: keep canonical paths like `/console/models/:id` and translate UI cluster state to `?cluster=deploy`. For section-level links use hash fragments like `#panel=alerts`. That keeps bookmarks stable and is friendly to servers.

Priya: Accessibility notes: when a cluster becomes active announce "Now in Deploy" via a polite live region and move focus to the cluster container's first interactive element. Add `aria-current="true"` on the active rail item and `aria-expanded` on toggles.

Kei: Good. Also want breadcrumbs richer: instead of "Models / 42" show "Models › ImageGen v2 (42)". For long names use middle truncation at 45 chars and reveal full name on hover or long-press. Mobile should show abbreviated form.

Marta: Analytics / logs: if we rely on query params we should emit a normalized path for reporting (e.g., `/console/models/:id/cluster/deploy`) so dashboards stay stable. Also preserve utm params through redirects.

Devon: Implementation note: use `history.replaceState` when mapping hashes to router state so we don't bloat back history. Pseudocode:

```
const { hash } = location;
if (hash.startsWith('#panel=')) {
  const panel = new URLSearchParams(hash.slice(1)).get('panel');
  router.replace({ pathname: location.pathname, query: { ...router.query, panel } }, undefined, { shallow: true });
  focusPanel(panel);
}
```

This avoids pushState spam.

Priya: When programmatically focusing a panel call `announceForAccessibility('Panel: ' + panelLabel)` and ensure each panel has `role="region"` + `aria-labelledby`. Tests should include screen-reader narration checks.

Kei: Keyboard power users: add one-key jump shortcuts like `g d` -> jump to Deploy, `g b` -> Build, plus an optional persisted preference. Order of precedence: URL params/fragment > explicit keyboard action > stored preference.

Marta: Migration plan: 1) routing shim that resolves legacy paths and preserves non-routing query params (Marta), 2) ARIA + live-region + tests (Priya), 3) breadcrumb copy + truncation guidelines + mock updates (Kei). Sync Fri 9:30.

Devon: I'll open a PR with the routing adaptor and a small server-side fallback to map old paths. Will add unit tests to assert utm preservation and analytics mapping. ETA Wed.

Priya: I'll add ARIA attrs + an `axe-core` run against a11y regression suite. Will paste results in thread and include a tiny keyboard E2E using Playwright.

Kei: I'll draft breadcrumb rules (max 45 chars, middle truncation, tooltip text = full slug, show version if available) and post updated mock + Loom.

NotifyBot: Reminder: Sync scheduled Fri 09:30. Calendar invite sent.

Marta: Minor UX nit: when switching clusters visually, avoid animating content height in a way that causes layout shift for keyboard users. Use cross-fade or instant swap.

Devon: Noted. Will include an opt-in CSS flag `--pref-reduced-motion` mapping and test for layout shift in Percy.

Priya: Also add `aria-live="polite"` region for cluster name changes and ensure it's cleared after announcement to avoid repeated reads.

Kei: Thanks team  small rollout plan sounds good. I'll open an RFC with mocks, migration checklist, and rollout gating criteria. :rocket:
